## Checklist
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keystores or personal data added (code, docs, tests, examples, commit messages)
- [ ] Any new config is read from env and documented in `.env.example` with a placeholder
- [ ] No hardcoded IPs, names, serials, paths or account IDs
- [ ] Any new assets are licensed for public use (source noted below)
- [ ] Changes to the TV can be undone, and the restore step is documented
- [ ] Relevant docs updated (see the doc-update rule in `CLAUDE.md`)
